lines.text: Searching for answers in the quiet night,
Wondering if you'll ever hold me tight.
I've got questions, need to hear your voice,
Tell me now, make the right choice.
No more waiting in the dark,
Light a spark, hit the mark.
This is what I need, your love so true,
Wrap me up, see me through.
No games, no lies, just you and me,
What I need, set my heart free.
Friends say be patient, but time flies fast,
Want your affection, make it last.
Eyes locked, feelings overflow,
Deep inside, I already know.
For heaven's sake, no more fake.
This is what I need, your love so true,
Wrap me up, see me through.
No games, no lies, just you and me,
What I need, set my heart free.
One chance to make it right,
Hold on through the night.
This is what I need, your love so true,
Wrap me up, see me through.
No games, no lies, just you and me,
What I need, eternally.
